blocks.text: Cebu City, Philippines — A young Palawan pangolin, known locally as “balintong,” was safely brought back to its habitat on November 4, 2026, following a rescue operation and assessment by the Municipal Environment and Natural Resources Office of Roxas, Palawan. Listed as a critically endangered species, the rescued Palawan pangolin measures 79.5 centimeters in length and has an estimated weight of 2 kilograms.
